scripts.build: npm run build -w @campusconnection/shared && npm run build -w @campusconnection/backend && npm run build -w @campusconnection/frontend
scripts.dev:api: npm run dev:shared && npm run dev -w @campusconnection/backend -- api
scripts.dev:realtime: npm run dev:shared && npm run dev -w @campusconnection/backend -- realtime
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @campusconnection/shared && npm run typecheck -w @campusconnection/backend && npm run typecheck -w @campusconnection/frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:unit -w @campusconnection/backend && npm run test:integration -w @campusconnection/backend
